Manufacturer promotion.

The Stanley Sort Master organiser is a robust storage solution for small parts, fixings, and accessories, designed for durability and efficient organisation. Constructed from hard-wearing polypropylene, this versatile tool box features 90° corner storage and customisable, removable dividers that offer 1024 compartment variations to accommodate components. Its hinged lid, secured by lockable plastic clamps, ensures contents remain safe and in place during transit, making it an ideal choice for tradespeople working across different sites, or for workshop organisation. A convenient carrying handle aids portability, and the water-resistant design protects stored items.
